sections.name: case loading guard
sections.title: Loading decision checks
sections.what: Checks that a case already loading is not requested again, that a missing case is loaded, that a ready case is not reloaded in the same language, and that it is reloaded when the language changes.
sections.why: Likely reason: prevents duplicate requests and keeps Hindi and English text in step.
sections.watch_out: Error states are not covered by these checks.

summary: Tests the rule that decides when the app should load or refresh a case in the browser.
purpose: Checks that a case already loading is not requested again, a missing case is loaded, and a ready case is reloaded only when the language has changed.
why: Likely reason: this avoids repeated requests for the same case and keeps the displayed language up to date.
how: Section one imports the rule and test tools. Section two checks four situations: a loading case is left alone, a missing case is loaded, a ready case in the same language is left alone, and a ready case in a different language is reloaded.
inputs: Sample case states and a language.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: Only the loading rule is tested here. Error handling and the surrounding loading behaviour are not.
debug: If cases reload too often or never refresh, check the rule and the effect that calls it in the case context file.
